title: codec-review adversarial round output. Derived from the OpenAI Codex plugin schemas/review-output.schema.json (Apache-2.0, Copyright 2026 OpenAI) and modified; see NOTICE and LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt in the repository root.

verdict.description: approved = sound enough to implement as written. revise = at least one material problem remains. Never approve to be agreeable.

summary.description: One paragraph: the strongest remaining reason this should not ship, or why it is now sound.

findings.description: Material findings only. No style, naming, or low-value cleanup. Empty array when verdict is approved.

id.description: Stable short id, e.g. F1, F2. Reuse the same id across rounds when re-raising the same finding.

what_breaks.description: The concrete failure: inputs or state, then the wrong outcome.

why_vulnerable.description: Why this specific code path or plan step admits that failure. Cite evidence you actually read.

impact.description: Likely blast radius: data loss, auth bypass, silent corruption, downtime, cost.

recommendation.description: One concrete change that reduces the risk.

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence from 0 to 1 that this finding is real. Do not inflate.

file.description: Repo-relative file path, or the reviewed document's path, or the plan section heading when the finding is not file-anchored.

line_start.description: First relevant line, or null when the finding is not line-anchored.

line_end.description: Last relevant line, or null when the finding is not line-anchored.

prior_round_response.description: On re-review only: why the builder's response to this finding in an earlier round was insufficient. Null on first sighting.

next_steps.description: Ordered, concrete actions. Empty array when verdict is approved.

settled.description: Ids of findings from earlier rounds you now consider resolved. Do not re-litigate these. Empty array in round 1.
